source.title: Distribución de cartera por producto
source.official_description: Saldo mensual por entidad, modalidad, producto, altura de mora y calificación de riesgo.
source.raw_file_integrity_note: Hash identifies the exact CSV input used for this build. The archived Drive gzip was not byte-compared; this does not assert byte identity with that archive.

grain: One row per reporting month × SFC product/modality code (unicap), aggregated by summing reporting-entity product-total lines (renglon=5).

transformations.product_total_filter: renglon == 5; excludes lower-level product lines to prevent double counting.
transformations.auxiliary: Raw aggregate balances by A-E, gross balance, number of reporting entities, and source rows are retained in the derived CSV.
transformations.delinquency_bands: Not used; overlapping delinquency-height columns are excluded.
transformations.amount_units: Source balances are kept in source units; no currency/unit conversion is applied. Ratios are unit invariant.

interpretation.claim: Descriptive portfolio mix proxy: the share of balances assigned to SFC risk grades D or E among balances assigned any A-E grade, by product and month.
interpretation.comparability: Use within-product historical monitoring only. Product definitions, rating practices, reporting entities and their mix can vary over time and across products; the ratios are not directly rank-comparable across modalities.
interpretation.denominator: Rated balance A-E, not gross balance. The separate coverage field shows rated balance divided by gross balance; where it is materially below 100%, the proxy covers only a subset of gross portfolio.
interpretation.integrity: The raw hash binds this build to its exact input. The Drive canonical file ID/path are recorded for lineage. At runtime the script also validates schema, the composite detail key, numeric saldos, and uniqueness of the derived month-product grain. Drive archive byte equality is not claimed.
